flags: 'Superhuman' is the rebranded parent company formerly known as Grammarly Inc. (rebranded October 2025). The company owns Grammarly, Coda, and Mail. The privacy policy URL redirects to the Grammarly domain, indicating a shared privacy framework across products.

Products are listed separately but are part of an integrated suite, and individual products may have varying compliance postures: Mail and Go are primary Superhuman products, while Grammarly and Docs are acquisitions under the Superhuman brand.
Superhuman explicitly does not offer HIPAA compliance or sign Business Associate Agreements.
There is no self-hosting option; all products are cloud-based SaaS only.
Data residency defaults to the US; European data is handled under European frameworks (GDPR, DPF, SCCs).
Superhuman Mail distinguishes itself with zero-knowledge local storage (the inbox is not stored on servers), reducing data exposure for email content.
